svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — R0 High-Level Design

Target state at end of R0 · one RM — the certified Specified Person — sells one Term Life policy to one ETB customer of one Group A insurer, end to end, evidenced, audited · an Insurance Partner Rep may assist, never sell · WS-3 (primary) + WS-1 (supplier) + WS-2 (enabler)
R0 OUTCOME — THE JOURNEY THAT MUST RUN END TO END
HOW TO READ THIS AGAINST THE NORTH STAR

Same ten boundaries, same context numbers, same names as docs/hdl.svg — this file simply shows what release zero contains. Where a boundary is thin in R0 it is still drawn, with what arrives later greyed and carrying its release.

Colour here encodes BUILD WAVE (in what order); colour on the North Star encodes RELEASE (when). The LOB encoding — rose cell and LIFE tag — is identical in both files and is the one thing you can read straight across.
R0: two actors — one sells, one assists
roles: RM · IPR · admin/ops — not apps
token-hiding session — no OAuth on device
role on NIP-APP · ASSIST ONLY — not an SP
browser / SMS link · consent OTP and
never on an RM or bank device (C4)
NTB prospect with no CIF. Arrives with
are all R1/R2 actors on the SAME journey
EDGE — THE ONLY PUBLIC ENTRY POINT
Edge — Cloudflare · F5 BIG-IP · External ALB · API Gateway · internal ALB

the bank perimeter and public entry point; every service, database and cache sits in a private subnet · TLS termination, F5 WAF rules, throttling and request validation here — no business logic, no authorization decision
inbound provider webhooks: mTLS + signature check before anything else. R0 polls instead (S-11)
R0 ships one NIP BFF — one per CHANNEL, never per channel × LOB
stateless session facade — holds the OAuth tokens;
NIP-APP only ever sees an opaque session (S-01).
Admin/MIS are role-gated routes here — not a second BFF
the DIY surface: customer identity, resume-link
Deferred at S13 — not on the path to one proven journey
work queues, journey search, interaction timeline,
server-side, never by hiding a button
not a BFF — admin/ops on NIP-APP
R0 UI over #19 + MIS is a role on NIP-APP
served by #2. Isolated read — never Lead writer
SHARED PLATFORM PLANE — BUILT ONCE FOR EVERY LOB
one instance, whatever the line of business (LB-5)

OWNS · what means the same thing for Life, Health and Motor: who the customer is, why we are contacting them, what we are permitted to do, where the journey is, what was paid, what is held. DOES NOT OWN · how a product is quoted, proposed or underwritten — that is boundary 5.
Keycloak first · provider-neutral · federates Bank AD
RBAC + ABAC · default deny · 300 ms · no retry
FAIL CLOSED (S-02) · grants keyed by (lob, actorType, roleId)
every WS-3 service asks the PDP — IdP claims
#9 Journey Orchestration — the R0 state machine
holds stage and references ONLY — never another context's business decision (SC-W3-6) · durable compensation tasks (S-19) · blocked from SOLD until audit confirms (INV-JRN-05)
journey step definitions and transitions resolved from configuration by (lob, journeyType, version) — the Journey Registry / LOB Router split is R1 (CF-2)
hard gate: no quote without a
R0 matrix: Life · Group A · Term ·
No work queue exists in R0
#19 Configuration — versioned · append-only · effective-dated · seeded · LOB-partitioned · ADMIN UI IN R0 W4

journey steps · rule packs · field validations · document checklists · product eligibility · role→permission grants · provider routing · attribution — every domain keyed by lob (CF-2) · no compiled-in fallback: an unresolvable rule is a refusal, not a default (S-21)
LOB EXECUTION CELL PLANE — WHERE THE INSURANCE BUSINESS ACTUALLY DIFFERS

OWNS · the per-LOB execution that cannot be shared. A Life quote, a Health quote and a Motor quote do not share a field shape, so Quote and Proposal are per-LOB and that boundary is FROZEN — sharing the service produces the if (lob == …) sprawl this design exists to prevent.

DOES NOT OWN · customer, lead, consent, catalogue, payment, policy registry, notification or audit — those are boundary 4 above, one instance for every line of business. Nor the underwriting decision: that is the insurer’s.
LIFE CELL — the only cell R0 builds
refuses without a valid suitability id (403) ·
age · sum assured · term · frequency · smoker
thin · no auto-retry on submit; poll to
Health and General get their OWN #10 and #11 — a second instance, never an if (lob == …) branch (LB-4, frozen boundary)
database, cache and topics — reusing boundary 4 unchanged.
No health-customer, health-consent or health-payment service.
Entry condition: WS-1 Phase 5 unfrozen, and R0–R2 have
proven the shared platform with real volume.
Same pattern again, with productLine = MOTOR | TRAVEL |
HOME | PA inside lob = GENERAL. Inspection replaces medical;
the GI quote shape (IDV, NCB, add-ons) is native, not a branch.
Third proof that adding a line of business is a cell plus
no WS-3 service calls an adapter directly (SC-W3-5)
ALL provider traffic routes here (SC-W3-5) · IF-1 canonical contract · async-poll · per-provider bulkheads
distributorId injected server-side, a caller-supplied value is rejected (INV-DIS-01) · routing policy keyed by (lob, productClass, version)
provider route that exists in R0
routing on lob × product × insurer × operation,
and insurer webhooks terminating on mTLS +
signature. R0 has one route and polls instead
EXTERNAL BOUNDARIES — BANK SYSTEMS vs INSURANCE PROVIDERS
WS-2 Phase 2 — the adapter exists first
CIF · ETB customer lookup and prefill.
Group A insurers · Term only in R0.
ownership per context · ONE cluster at R0 (ADR-008)
a SCHEMA per context · Multi-AZ · PITR
shared platform + life_* cell schemas, split-ready
India regions only, enforced by policy-as-code

INVARIANT · one owner per authoritative datum · no service reads another's tables · per-context credential with NO cross-schema grant — ArchUnit + IAM, verified in the S09 IaC scan. DECISION (ADR-008, amending ARCH-004) · a physical cluster per service is NOT a principle.

R0 runs ONE Aurora cluster with a schema per context. The first physical split follows the LOB-CELL / SHARED-PLATFORM seam, not the service boundary — life_* becomes its own cluster when load justifies it, with no application redesign. One cluster is one blast radius: that is the trade, and it is

why isolation now rests entirely on credentials and grants. Aarti (Database) and Deepali (Security) approvals outstanding. The existing bank-persistence-service stays scoped to the integration job store and audit ingestion — it is NOT extended to the R0 business contexts.
outbox in front of a broker — the outbox is the source of truth
Transactional outbox to MSK — the outbox stays the source of truth
service DB → outbox row (one txn) → publisher → MSK topic (S-23) → consumers dedupe on eventId (S-24). Audit (S-17) and
Notification (S-18) consume. NO regulatory evidence exists only in a topic — the audit write is the record (ADR-012, FF-26).
Synchronous vs asynchronous — the rule R0 applies
MUST be synchronous: authorization (S-02), configuration resolution (S-21), critical validation, payment session (S-13).
MAY be asynchronous: audit ingestion, notification, quote and proposal polling. A notification or audit outage never fails a sale.
PLATFORM ENGINEERING & GOVERNANCE PLANE — IF-3, THE PAVED ROAD
built once in WS-3; consumed by WS-1, WS-2 and WS-3
Waves W0b–W4 above start only after GATE-S08 passes and the S09 critical path lands. This is where the platform actually is today.
CI builds + tests every module on every PR · merge impossible without green · coverage floors (libs 80 / 70) · ArchUnit + 28 fitness functions (FF-01…FF-28)
secret / SAST / SCA / image scanning · no PII in logs, proven by automated test · p95 pipeline feedback < 10 min · engineering standards published
Approvers: Amit (Eng) · Swapnali (QA) · Mahesh (Arch) · Deepali (Sec) · Shivanshi (SRE)
S09 — Platform & Environment Foundation (overlapped with S08)
IaC + environments (dev → UAT → prod) · secrets & KMS hierarchy · observability substrate · 7-year write-once retention in ap-south-1
restore executed and timed (S09-G7) — "a backup that has never been restored is a hypothesis" · DR warm standby in ap-south-2
IaC policy-as-code: India regions only (FF-08) · no public / unencrypted store, no wildcard prod IAM (FF-09) · audit store immutability (FF-10)
not in R0 — greyed, carrying the release it arrives in
non-waivable control — a ROUNDED pill (C1 · C2 · C4)
LOB partition tag — a SQUARE tag. Different thing.
journey step (the ribbon at the top)
LINE OF BUSINESS — WHICH BOXES GET A SECOND COPY
The question this diagram exists to answer once Health is on the table. LB-4 and LB-5 decide it.
1 · LOB-OWNED EXECUTION — inside the rose cell
Health and General each get their OWN instance.
The boundary is FROZEN: a Life quote and a Health quote
do not share a field shape.
2 · LOB-PARTITIONED SHARED — carries the LIFE tag
ONE codebase, ONE deployment. Behaviour is resolved from
configuration keyed by (lob, …) per CF-2 — never forked,
never branched on an lob literal (CF-1, FF-18).
3 · LOB-AGNOSTIC SHARED — no tag, outside every cell
One instance for every line of business, forever.
Partitioning the RULES is what makes the Health cell
possible; duplicating the EVIDENCE makes it unauditable.
WHAT R0 DOES NOT CONTAIN, AND WHEN IT ARRIVES
Greyed on the diagram above. Each is an out_of_scope entry in CURRENT-STATE.yaml
#1 Customer BFF — not on the assisted R0 path (DIY)
Campaign and bulk demand management on top of #5 — origination itself is W1 (AC-9)
Customer DIY journey · Group B insurers · ULIP and Savings · document platform · hi-IN
Journey Registry / LOB Router split · provider router · callback gateway
Hybrid assisted ⇄ DIY · call centre · work management · renewal and lapse · NTB + V-KYC
HEALTH cell — gated on WS-1 Phase 5 being unfrozen
GENERAL / MOTOR cell — productLine inside lob = GENERAL
No service mesh, no per-service clusters, no analytics warehouse, no cache-backed idempotency in R0 — each a recorded decision
the customer's own device is a first-class surface — C4 lives here, never on a bank device
north-south contract only — no business logic and no authorization decision at the edge
S-03 · the BFF holds session state and nothing else; every call is re-authorized by the PDP (S-02)
#9 resolves the LOB and routes to the owning cell — a single-LOB pass-through in R0; the real router is R1
bank-canonical request — the cell does not know 1SB exists (IF-1, SC-W3-5)
mTLS · the only provider route R0 has
behaviour from here — S-21, fail closed
not drawn as lines — an edge that crosses four bands teaches nothing and hides everything behind it
